@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · dsh-focus-chat：> [!WARNING]
> **This project is archived and no longer developed.**
>
> The official dsh web UI now supports this plugin's functionality natively: **Settings → Work details** (`Compact` / `Detailed` / `Expanded`) folds a turn's process into a compact reading line, and it has shipped since dsh **0.1.7-alpha.1**. There is no longer any reason to install this plugin.
>
> 
>
> **Migrating off the plugin** — remove it from your web profile and restart; the built-in setting takes over:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web remove @dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat
> dsh web
> ```
>
> The repository is read-only from here on: no further releases, issues, or pull requests.
@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · dsh-focus-chat：A plugin for the dsh web GUI that adds a **focus chat** tab — a condensed, Claude Code–style way to read a conversation.

Instead of watching every step live, one assistant turn collapses into a single summary line:

> Thought for 36s, edited 8 files, read 17 files, listed 18 directories, ran 2 shell commands, loaded 3 context items

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Screenshots：A whole turn can fold further into one `Worked for Xm Ys` line — expanding it draws the full detail (tool cards, thinking, context, produced files, copy/fork) exactly like the chat rows; mid-turn interjections split the fold into per-stretch lines, and a stopped turn reads `Stopped after X`. **After a refresh the whole conversation shows up folded**: every turn beyond the ~50-message window renders from a Host-side index as "user message + worked-for line + the assistant's actual closing reply", and its process detail loads only when that fold expands. Very long histories page the fold stack via "Load earlier turns"; a missing index silently degrades to the in-window folds.
@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Screenshots：Switch to it whenever you want the "what happened?" view, and flip back for the full transcript.

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Install (deprecated)：> The plugin is archived; prefer the built-in **Work details** setting described in the warning above. The steps below are kept only for existing installs.

```sh
@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Install from npm (requires dsh >= 0.1.6-alpha.1)：dsh plugin --profile web add @dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Restart dsh web; the tab mounts automatically：dsh web
```

Then open the Focus chat tab in any conversation.

Notes:

- `dsh plugin` behaves like adding a dependency to your web profile. A bundle plugin is loaded once its full package name appears in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list (adds automatically on recent dsh builds; add it manually if your build does not); the bundle patch applies on the next boot.
- With the repo source-launched CLI, run the args through the bin directly (`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts ...`).

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · What's missing：- **Inspect focuses the trajectory view.** A tool row's Inspect action opens the official trajectory view on that call (`openView('trajectory', callId)`) — the 0.1.5 replacement for the removed details panel. Focus cannot render third-party keyed tool views (see the next bullet).
- **Third-party tool-card extensions don't render here.** Cards that other plugins add to the chat view won't appear in the focus view; the built-in card renderers are used instead.
- **Folding is per consecutive tool-run.** Any visible content between two runs (a reply, a command, your interjection) keeps them separate.
- **Inline file links need the optional file-mentions service** — the same off switch the chat view uses.
- **Remote fold lines lack a few window-only readings.** The turn navigator rail lists window turns only; remote turns render no produced-file list (the ui-deliverables turn data), no inline file mentions, and their closing reply cannot fork (branching stays available on window turns). Per-message feedback (like/dislike) is unaffected.

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Development：> This build targets the dsh v0.1.6-alpha.1 client surface, and every `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime dependency installs from the npm registry (see `package.json`). The `/client` entries those packages ship are `window.__ModuleLoader__` browser closures, and the dsh test runtime is built against the source tree, so `yarn test` resolves the `@deepseek-ai` client surface from the dsh mainline source checkout at the same 0.1.6-alpha.1 line: `vitest.config.ts` derives its aliases from that checkout's own tsconfig path map (the `MAINLINE` constant in the config) — keep the checkout on the 0.1.6-alpha.1 release and everything else stays npm-installed.

@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Development：- `yarn run build` — builds the browser bundle and the Node half.
- `src/client/model/` — the pure logic (folding, merging, row models, the remote turn-slice projection); `src/client/view/FocusView.tsx` — the view; `src/host/` — the host half's turn index and RPC channel; `src/protocol.ts` — the wire contract shared by both halves.
- `yarn test` — behavior tests; `yarn run typecheck` — type gate.
- A `--dev` `dsh web` server hot-reloads rebuilt bundles — `yarn run build` alone is usually enough to see changes.
@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · Model Experience：None. The view is a pure client derivation over the already-logged conversation snapshot; nothing here reaches a model request.
@dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat README · KV Cache effect：None; this package neither assembles nor sends provider requests.

dsh-focus-chat 是面向 DSH Web 的对话聚焦阅读插件，在 conversation.view 槽注册独立的聚焦标签，并以主机侧回合索引补充较早历史。它将连续工具调用归并为带命令、文件、搜索等统计的摘要行，把已完成回合折叠为耗时摘要，同时保留用户消息与最终回复；展开后可查看工具卡片、思考、上下文和回合细节。旧回合按需读取事件切片，设置区可保存差异渲染与 Markdown 行内代码样式。适合希望快速浏览会话过程并按需回看细节的用户；代码没有声明必需 API 密钥或账号。

dsh-focus-chat adds a Focus tab to DSH Web, grouping consecutive tool calls into expandable summaries and folding completed turns into duration lines. Older turns load on demand; settings save diff and Markdown code styles. It requires no API key.
想把一整段 DSH 对话里的工具过程收起来，只先看做了什么。
能不能把每轮会话折叠成耗时摘要，同时保留最终回复？
我想快速扫过命令、文件和搜索调用的汇总，需要时再展开细节。
刷新页面后，怎么继续浏览加载窗口之外的旧回合？
希望对话阅读模式能显示每轮工作时长和思考时间。
想在会话界面切换代码差异和 Markdown 行内代码的显示样式。
I want a compact view that groups tool activity and lets me expand the details.
How can I browse completed conversation turns outside the loaded history window?
dsh-focus-chat 的功能「连续工具摘要」：将连续工具调用合并为一个可展开摘要组，并统计命令、编辑、搜索等类别；展开后可查看各调用行。
dsh-focus-chat 的功能「完成回合折叠」：已结束回合显示工作时长摘要，用户消息与最终回复保持可见，展开后可查看被折叠的过程。
dsh-focus-chat 的功能「历史回合展开」：主机生成完成回合索引，并按请求返回一个回合的事件切片，供客户端展开较早历史。
dsh-focus-chat 的功能「视图样式设置」：可分别选择文件差异的默认或 codex-bar 样式，以及 Markdown 行内代码的默认或高亮样式，并保存设置。
dsh-focus-chat 的功能「聚焦视图标签」：插件向 conversation.view 槽注册独立标签，用户可从对话界面切换到精简阅读视图。
dsh-focus-chat 使用须知：README 将仓库标为 archived，并建议改用 DSH 内置 Work details；此提交仍包含独立会话视图与折叠实现。安装前可确认自己需要插件视图还是内置功能。
